audit.reasoning: Coding 'fixed-dominant, final (final stress)' rests on an explicit stress section in the best available description (Lobel & Paputungan 2017, specialist fieldwork sketch with audio), now downloaded and verified verbatim at p. 334. The only other descriptive work (Danie et al. 1996, 425 pp) was downloaded via the Internet Archive and is silent on stress, so nothing contradicts the classification. Record housekeeping: 'quote', 'cite', 'loc' and 'grade' fields are empty even though sources[0] carries the quotation; populate them (loc = sec. 2.1, p. 334; primary source now obtained) and raise the strength of the evidence.
